sources.entry: Mac Cache Cleaner - Cache cleaner for Mac [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/kaunteya/MacCacheCleaner) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS cache cleaner app that removes cached files using cache definitions listed in a Source.json file, per the README, which is very short.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very brief and only contains a download link, a note that more cache definitions can be added in Source.json, and promotion for the author's other Mac apps (Lexi and Quick Note). It does not describe the cleaning process, which caches are covered by default, or any settings. The repository is listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Cleanup and Uninstall as an open-source, freeware cache cleaner for Mac. Beyond that, the README gives no further detail on how it works.
use_cases: free disk space on a Mac
extend cache cleanup rules via JSON
how_to_run: Download the app from the link in the README (no command-line steps given)
notable: Cache definitions are customizable via Source.json
Listed in awesome-mac under Cleanup and Uninstall
Open-source and freeware per awesome-mac listing
caveats: README is nearly empty; no detail on which caches are cleaned or how safely
No build or install instructions beyond a download link
License not named in the README
